independent_local_reviews.verdict: Scoped clear for the final report’s mechanical source and detector, static instrument loading, normal-incidence power, and lossless and damped slab guidance.
independent_local_reviews.limits: Physical light identification and free-mouth dynamics remain open. The quantum-pair sector was outside this review.
independent_local_reviews.disposition: Clarified the order of lossless and low-frequency limits, the shared complex tangential wave number in a damped guide, and single-piston forcing with the partner free to move.

independent_local_reviews.reviewer: Independent local source and pair reviewer
independent_local_reviews.verdict: CLEAR for the two-site bound-pair selection rules and clock comparison, the matched-face graph’s odd-sector spectrum, the reported closed-loop absorption lines, and the adiabatic differential-occupancy and circulating-current readouts for the stated Hamiltonians.
independent_local_reviews.limits: Identifying which laboratory optical source drives this phase, and which physical detector measures the constituent current, remains open.
independent_local_reviews.disposition: Added a guarded test of subthreshold dimer and closed-loop polarization; distinguished coherent readout and absorption and gave the dimer susceptibility in inverse hopping energy.
